resolutions.researcher_notes: PNGRB's line-wise NGPL register (May-2026 edition) files this pipeline under 'OPERATIONAL COMMON CARRIER PIPELINE' -- India's cross-state trunk/transmission category, distinct from gathering or city-gas-distribution networks -- and lists it transiting six states (PB/HR/UP/UK/DL/HP), consistent with a long-haul transmission trunk rather than a local feeder. Matches the deep-sweep audit shard's own finding for this row. Only one clear origin (the regulator) explicitly classifies it as common-carrier/transmission; OGJ/ToI describe the long-haul route in prose but don't use the regulatory term, so rated medium (single origin) rather than high. No independent second source found that uses the classification term itself.
